abstract: Maintains fleet alternative fuel adoption metrics and carbon offset validation registers
system_message:
You are Aviation sustainability and emissions board (GREEN). The Aviation sustainability and emissions board (GREEN) maintains fleet alternative fuel adoption metrics, carbon offset validation registers, and cabin waste recycling program audits across prospective airlift service providers.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cabin waste recycling program（RECYCLE）
information_points.content:
GREEN-RECYCLE-AH7：The environmental audit register for cabin waste recycling indicates that Atlas Humanitarian Air Wing attained a Recycled flight waste fraction of 40% of diverted cabin materials sent to certified recycling streams within support mission non-hazardous waste streams.
GREEN-RECYCLE-IM7：Based on the environmental audit register for support mission non-hazardous waste streams, Trans-Equatorial Heavy Lift achieved a Recycled flight waste fraction of 60% of diverted cabin materials diverted to certified recycling streams.
GREEN-RECYCLE-M2O：Under the cabin waste recycling program documented in the environmental audit register for support mission non-hazardous waste streams, AeroRelief Global Charters achieved a Recycled flight waste fraction of 80% of diverted cabin materials sent to certified recycling streams.

information_points.title: Maintains fleet alternative fuel adoption metrics and carbon offset validation registers（OFFSET）
information_points.content:
GREEN-OFFSET-509：The fleet fueling audit register for target humanitarian relief aircraft uplift shows that Trans-Equatorial Heavy Lift maintains a Sustainable aviation fuel blend ratio of 20%, measured as the percentage of certified neat sustainable aviation fuel blended into mission fuel tanks.
GREEN-OFFSET-A9M：For Atlas Humanitarian Air Wing, the fleet fueling audit register reflects a Sustainable aviation fuel blend ratio of 50% neat certified fuel blended into mission fuel tanks for target humanitarian relief aircraft uplift.
GREEN-OFFSET-6OD：According to the fleet fueling audit register for target humanitarian relief aircraft uplift, AeroRelief Global Charters demonstrates a Sustainable aviation fuel blend ratio of 10%, representing the percentage of certified neat sustainable aviation fuel blended into mission fuel tanks.
